# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_STAGE2_TOPKEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The sniper strategy with volume filter (1.1x average), minimum body size (2 cents), requiring 2 confirming stars, OTM strike offset of 2, 6% premium stop, 40% first TP, 300% runner target, immediate profit lock with 8% trailing stop, selling 2/3 at TP1, 10 contracts, proximity of $1.5 to level, and requiring break above open captures non-J day trends while avoiding losses on J loser days. However, it underperforms on J winner days relative to the J benchmark trades.

## Mechanism

Enter on sniper level break when: volume >= 1.1 * 20-bar average volume, candle body >= 2 cents, at least 2 confirming signals (from sniper design), strike is OTM by 2 strikes, and the price breaks above the open (for bullish bias? note: the parameter name suggests bullish, but we observed put-like behavior on some days - requires clarification). Exit 2/3 of position at 40% profit premium, move stop to breakeven via 8% trailing profit lock on remaining 1/3, with catastrophic stop at 6% premium loss or chart structure failure.
